hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-normal tracking-tighter leading-none

typography.notes: Do not center headings by default. Embrace asymmetry. Use Instrument Serif for a high-end, editorial magazine cover feel, contrasted heavily with technical IBM Plex Mono for overlines and labels.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use wide gap strategy (gap-8 to gap-12). Implement Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for features: mix col-span-8, col-span-4 to create asymmetry and tension.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Sharp corners only (rounded-none). 1px solid border-neutral-800 or border-[#262626] to expose the grid.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFCC00] text-black font-semibold rounded-none px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#E6B800] transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-neutral-700 text-white rounded-none px-6 py-3 hover:bg-neutral-900 hover:border-neutral-500 transition-all duration-300

components.cards: bg-[#141414] border border-[#262626] rounded-none p-8 hover:border-[#00E5FF]/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.05)] transition-all duration-500
components.navigation: Fixed header, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border-b border-[#262626]. Must have explicitly defined alignment.

motion.hero: Staggered reveal: Titles slide up from translateY(20px) with opacity 0 to 1 over 0.8s ease-out. Use staggerChildren.
motion.features: Scroll-triggered entrance with viewport once: true. Subtle micro-interactions on cards: hover scales image or adds a subtle glow.
motion.apps_grid: Tempting exhibition pieces. Hover applies magnetic pull or scale(1.02) to the image container, text shifts slightly.

sections_blueprint.name: Navigation
sections_blueprint.content: Brand Logo (Gonzo Labs / Atlas), Links (Features, Studio Apps, Pricing). CTA: 'Enter Atlas' (if auth token exists) or 'Sign In'.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Section
sections_blueprint.content: Cinematic headline (e.g., 'Build the future, pixel by pixel.'). Subtitle explaining the studio. CTAs: 'Enter the app' (Primary), 'Try free' (Secondary).
sections_blueprint.visuals: Massive Instrument Serif typography. Asymmetrical layout (text left-aligned, right side empty or floating 3D/blueprint abstract). Dark blueprint background texture.

sections_blueprint.name: Stats & Trust Band
sections_blueprint.content: Metrics: '// 1200+ BLUEPRINTS TRACED', '// 8 HOURS SAVED PER PROJECT'.
sections_blueprint.visuals: Monospace ticker or stark, brutalist grid row with neon cyan accents. High-contrast text.

sections_blueprint.name: Atlas Features Showcase
sections_blueprint.content: Highlight 5-6 features: AI blueprint extraction, 2D CAD editor, 3D render, Pay-app generation, Field execution, B2B portals.
sections_blueprint.visuals: Bento 'Tetris' grid. Large cards (col-span-8) for major features (3D render, CAD), small cards (col-span-4) for lists/logs. Use styled divs (bg-neutral-900 border-neutral-800) as mock placeholders for screenshots.

sections_blueprint.name: Apps Hub Grid
sections_blueprint.visuals: Atlas card is vibrant and clickable. 'Coming Soon' cards use wireframe/blueprint styling (border-dashed border-neutral-700 text-neutral-600) but maintain the exact same grid dimensions. Feels like an art exhibition.

sections_blueprint.name: Pricing Tease
sections_blueprint.visuals: Grid borders (Technical look). Exposed skeleton grid layout. Clean typography.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
sections_blueprint.content: Massive Gonzo Labs mark, sitemap, contact.
sections_blueprint.visuals: Massive typography (text-[10vw]). Deep dark surface. Contrast shift from main body.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion lucide-react`.
Update `tailwind.config.js` with the custom fonts and color palette defined in these guidelines.
Route Architecture: In `App.js`, create a new `<Landing />` page at `/`. Move the existing Auth/Sign-in logic to `/signin`. Signed-in users at `/signin` should redirect to `/app`.
Implement the Layout: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layout. Avoid Shadcn for macro layouts; use raw divs to achieve the necessary asymmetry and bento grids.
Component Rules: Ensure EVERY interactive element (buttons, links) has a unique `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="hero-try-free-cta"`).

Mock Images: For Atlas screenshots, build placeholder divs using `bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800` to indicate exactly where the user should drop their real screenshots later. Do not use generic stock photos for UI screens.
Aesthetics: Absolutely NO standard Vercel/Stripe purple gradients. Stick strictly to #0A0A0A base, #FFCC00 primary, and #00E5FF accents. Do not center everything; use left-aligned tension.
Motion: Use framer-motion for the Hero staggered entrance and scroll-triggered reveals for the features and apps grid.
